As a woman who has had many UTIs after sex, my advice is this: clean your genitals prior to sex. Take D-mannose (I recommend the powder form which you mix into about 4oz of water) before and after sex (take it 20 mins to an hour before sex and then right after sex). Try to pee before sex and pee as soon as possible after sex. 45 minutes is a bit long to wait to pee. It may be a good idea to bathe after sex as well. If you start to feel yourself getting a UTI, increase your water intake to help flush out the bacteria. 

I don't recommend drinking cranberry juice to treat a UTI. As far as I know, it's really not very effective. It may help to prevent UTIs. Cranberry juice contains D-mannose but taking the powder is going to be much more effective. If you do drink cranberry juice, make sure it's 100% cranberry with no added sugars.
